title: Debt and Deadline
author: Quentin Okonkwo
blurb: Jonah Blackwood, a fixer for an embassy that doesn't officially exist, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
